source.title: Recovered Sanctum Bow - 12.1.5 PTR Wowhead item-side Looter aggregate
source.author: Wowhead Looter aggregate

notes: PTR item-side aggregate says 24 disenchants; this is NOT 24 independently verified current Retail operation receipts. WoWDB PTR base 251259 displays Cannot be disenchanted, while Wowhead shows selected scaled ilvl 227 version without source-at-cast bonus/ilvl. The multiple output rows share the SAME pooled denominator. Material identity/rank not linked, not eligible for numeric live estimator. No event-level zeros, conditional observed min/max or units, skill, spec, dates, refunds. PTR and live item previews are not independent studies.
